title: MSc Digital Marketing (2027 entry) | The University of Manchester

facts.fact: The MSc Digital Marketing course has a year of entry of 2027 and a duration of 1 year full time.
The course is delivered in person, full time, on campus.
Alliance Manchester Business School is ranked 4th in the UK for marketing, according to the QS Business Masters Ranking 2027 (a third-party ranking cited by the university).
facts.quote: ranked 4th in the UK and 15th in the world for marketing (QS Business Masters Ranking 2027)

facts.fact: Alliance Manchester Business School is ranked 15th in the world for marketing, according to the QS Business Masters Ranking 2027 (a third-party ranking cited by the university).
facts.quote: ranked 4th in the UK and 15th in the world for marketing (QS Business Masters Ranking 2027)

facts.fact: The university requires a First or Upper Second class honours degree (2:1, with a 60% average) from a UK university or the overseas equivalent for entry to this course.
facts.quote: We require a First or Upper Second class honours degree (2:1, with 60% average) from a UK university or the overseas equivalent.

facts.fact: Some English language test results are valid for only two years, and the test report must be valid on the course start date.
facts.quote: Some English Language test results are only valid for two years.

facts.fact: Alliance Manchester Business School was established in 1965 as one of the UK's first two business schools.
facts.quote: Alliance Manchester Business School was established in 1965 as one of the UK's first two business schools.
